name: Double Camp Campground
note: Primitive Forest Service camping in a small gravel clearing beside Citico Creek where Doublecamp-Jake Best Rd (FS 2659) leaves Citico Creek Rd (FS 35-1), about 2 km north of Indian Boundary. The Forest Service gives no site count, rig length or facilities, so pad size and amenities are unconfirmed; call the Tellico Ranger District before setting out. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: Cherokee NF alert 'Citico Creek Flood Closure' (fs.usda.gov/r08/cherokee/alerts/citico-creek-flood-closure, start 2026-07-23, updated 2026-10-13, read 2026-11-25) names it as an FS campground ('Jake Best Campground remains open while Double Camp Campground is closed.') and closes its access roads ('NFSR 35-1 Citico Creek Rd Closure'; 'NFSR 2659 Doublecamp-Jake Best Rd Closure: 35.463171, -84.030705 to 35.418464, -84.088762'; 'The road is impassable and access is currently closed to motorized vehicles'; attached FS map 'Closed from 09/14/2026 until Further Notice'). No FS recreation page and no recreation.gov listing (rec.gov search for 'double camp'/'doublecamp'/'citico', read 2026-11-25) -> first-come only. Esri imagery at the pin shows a gravel clearing with parked vehicles beside the creek (drive-in). Camper reports: The Dyrt 'Double Camp/Citico Creek' (4 reviews 2018-2024, latest 2024-06-20 naming site 11; 'Park next to your site'), Campendium 'Doublecamp Designated Campsites' ($0, no reservations), RV Life 254073 (usfs, unrated, $). No FS rig length or RV wording anywhere -> kept as unclear pad size with a caveat (AWH 2026-11-02) and as a small free NF site on camper reports (AWH 2026-11-12), and added while closed with status (caveat, don't withhold). Public: no price gate.
waterfront_evidence: 2026-11-25: Esri World_Imagery z17/z18 at 35.4185,-84.0889 shows one small gravel clearing (~40 x 20 m, vehicles parked) north of the creek, with a band of canopy along the bank between the clearing and the water; the stream is well under ~30 m wide (creekside at most). USGS 3DEP point elevations: clearing 427.8-428.2 m, creek-edge point ~25-30 m SE (35.41830,-84.08850) 425.6 m, so the clearing is ~2-2.5 m above the stream over roughly 25 m. No source names sites or pads at the water (The Dyrt 'Great creekside camping', 2020, is a review snippet and cannot be the basis), and the bank under the tree band is not visible. Defaulted down to not waterfront. Lead: a creekside candidate if dated site photos show pads at the stream with an easy walk down once the road reopens.

status.note: Closed since the July 2026 Citico Creek flood: the Forest Service says large parts of Citico Creek Rd (FS 35-1) and Doublecamp-Jake Best Rd (FS 2659) washed out and the route is impassable and closed to motor vehicles, 'until further notice'. Jake Best, downstream, stays open. Call the Tellico Ranger District before planning a stay.

flags: Added while closed (status temporarily_closed, reopening not announced). add_results.py does not carry `status`: write the status group and status_source by hand or the entry goes on the map as open.

What 'Double Camp' is: the FS has no recreation page, map symbol or rec.gov listing for it - only the flood alert names 'Double Camp Campground'. The FS closure map draws campground symbols for Jake Best and Indian Boundary only. Aggregators (The Dyrt, Campendium, RV Life, Snoflo) all pin it at the FS 35-1 / FS 2659 junction (35.4185,-84.0889), where imagery shows one gravel clearing; it looks like a designated primitive site cluster rather than a developed campground. If AWH reads it as dispersed camping without an agency designation, it is a skip (the alert's naming is the only designation).
Fees group omitted: the FS posts no fee for Double Camp. Campendium ($0) and Campflare's Citico Creek Dispersed Campsites ('Free access with no permit required') say free; Jake Best nearby is $6.
Facilities: no toilets per Campflare/Snoflo (aggregators, not used); FS area page gives no restroom information. Only potable_water false is written.

Season and sites groups omitted: no agency source (Campflare says open year-round; no site count anywhere - The Dyrt reviews name sites 10, 11 and 13, numbering shared with the Citico Creek designated sites along FS 35-1).

Access wording: no FS RV/trailer or 4WD wording for FS 35-1; Jake Best's directions call the route 'the gravel road which will drop you down to Citico Creek'. An onX offroad page (not agency) calls FS 2659 above the junction rocky; the site sits at its foot, reached on FS 35-1.
The July 2026 flood may have damaged the site itself; post-flood imagery is not available, so recheck the clearing when the road reopens.
Elevation: Open-Meteo 465 m at the pin (coarse DEM in a narrow valley); USGS 3DEP gives ~428 m at the clearing.
Phone is the Tellico Ranger District number on the alert (same as Jake Best 4420 and Birch Branch).
No gateway within 40 km (gateways.py: Smokies 42 km) - irrelevant for a federal campground.
Wayback was offline during this read (no archived FS page for Double Camp could be checked).
